column1: Write a Go function named Tribonacci that takes an int n and returns the nth Tribonacci number using an iterative approach (T(0)=0, T(1)=0, T(2)=1). Function signature: func Tribonacci(n int) int. Include a main function printing Tribonacci(10).

Write a Go HTTP handler function HandleCreateOrder that accepts POST requests to /orders with a JSON body containing 'customer_id' (int) and 'amount' (float64). Validate customer_id is nonzero and amount is greater than 0. Return 201 Created with the order JSON on success, 400 Bad Request on failure. Use standard library only.

Write a Go function ReadYAML that reads a YAML file from a given path. Since standard library has no YAML support, read the file as raw bytes and return them as a string, wrapping all IO errors using fmt.Errorf with %w. Signature: func ReadYAML(path string) (string, error)

Write a Go function named SumDigits that takes an int n and returns the sum of all its digits using an iterative approach. Function signature: func SumDigits(n int) int. Include a main function that prints SumDigits(12345).

Write a Go HTTP handler HandleCreateComment that accepts POST /comments with JSON body containing 'post_id' (int) and 'body' (string). Validate post_id is nonzero and body is non-empty and under 1000 characters. Return 201 with comment JSON or 400 with error. Standard library only.

Write a Go function WatchFile that opens a file at a given path and reads its contents into a byte slice, retrying up to 3 times on error with a 1-second sleep between retries. Wrap the final error with fmt.Errorf and %w if all retries fail.

Write a Go Validate method for the following Address struct that checks: Street is not empty, City is not empty, ZipCode is exactly 5 digits (regexp or manual check), CountryCode is exactly 2 uppercase letters. Return descriptive errors:

type Address struct {
    Street      string
    City        string
    ZipCode     string
    CountryCode string
}

Write a Go function LinearSearch that performs linear search on a []int slice and returns the index of the target value or -1 if not found. Signature: func LinearSearch(arr []int, target int) int. Include a main demonstrating a search for value 42.

Write a Go HTTP handler HandleGetProduct that accepts GET requests to /products/:id where id is an integer path parameter. Look up a product in an in-memory map[int]Product. Return 200 with product JSON or 404 with error message if not found. Use standard library only.

Write a Go function ConfigFromFlags that reads the following from os.Args using the flag package: -host string (required), -port int (default 8080), -debug bool (default false). Return a Config struct and an error if -host is missing.
